summary: New patchy right infrahilar/mid-lung opacity in CURRENT not present in the clearer right lung of PRIOR.

findings.rationale: PRIOR right lung shows normal, uniform vascular markings; CURRENT shows a patchy, irregular increased density in the right infrahilar/mid zone medial to the expected scapular shadow. Caveat: differing arm position and mild rotation between exams complicate direct comparison.
